about.lead: Green Net Power Co., Ltd. is a power system engineering and consulting company based in Daejeon, Republic of Korea.
about.history: Our project experience includes FACTS control systems delivered to KEPCO Research Institute, a government-funded STATCOM coordinated-control program, 220 kV transmission feasibility studies, national transmission and substation planning, island microgrids, power quality engineering, and electricity tariff consulting.
about.principle: The scope, input data, study assumptions, analysis methods, results, and recommendations are documented for technical review and subsequent project work.

services.title: Power System Engineering Services
services.intro: Each scope of work is defined according to the power system, available data, applicable requirements, and project stage.
services.powerTitle: Power System Studies, Transmission Planning & Tariffs
services.powerDescription: Power flow, short-circuit, and stability studies for transmission planning, feasibility assessment, and system reinforcement.
services.powerItem1: Transmission feasibility studies and shared-use assessments
services.powerItem2: Power flow, short-circuit, and stability studies
services.powerItem3: Generation, transmission, and demand forecast reviews
services.powerItem4: Electricity tariff and cross-border power trade frameworks
services.renewablesDescription: Feasibility studies, system sizing, design review, construction supervision, commissioning support, and operating plans for off-grid and island power systems.
services.renewablesItem1: Solar PV, battery energy storage, and generator system sizing
services.renewablesItem2: Community and island power feasibility studies and construction management
services.renewablesItem3: Technical advisory for ADB and other international programs
services.qualityDescription: Analysis of voltage sags and other power quality disturbances, equipment impacts, and site-specific mitigation measures.

services.qualityItem3: FACTS control applications, including STATCOM and UPFC
services.trainingDescription: Design and supply of scaled laboratory systems for power networks and renewable energy applications, together with technical training.

services.trainingItem2: Grid operation, SCADA/EMS, and FACTS training systems
services.trainingItem3: Laboratory equipment for universities and technical training institutes
services.deliverablesDescription: Scope and assumptions, input data review, system models, study cases, analysis results, option assessment, recommendations, and technical presentations.

approach.title: Study Process
approach.intro: The work program is agreed for each assignment and generally follows four stages.
approach.step1Description: Confirm the study objectives, system boundary, technical criteria, schedule, interfaces, and available data.
approach.step2Description: Prepare or validate the system model, define study cases, and perform the required power system analyses.
approach.step3Description: Review system performance, constraints, technical risks, and reinforcement or mitigation options.
approach.step4Description: Issue the study report, present the results, address technical comments, and support agreed follow-on work.
approach.principleDescription: Key inputs, assumptions, study cases, assessment criteria, and limitations are stated in the technical report.

projects.title: Selected Projects
projects.intro: Selected assignments in transmission planning, power system consulting, electricity tariffs, renewable energy, microgrids, and FACTS control.
projects.paraguayDescription: Technical advisory for Paraguay’s national transmission and substation planning, including power system studies and reviews of generation plans, network development plans, and demand forecasts.
projects.ethiopiaTariffTitle: Development of an Ethiopian Electricity Tariff Negotiation Framework
projects.ethiopiaTariffDescription: Development of a standardized framework for electricity tariff negotiations, covering domestic tariff structures and cross-border power trade.
projects.omanDescription: Review of Oman’s power system, generation and transmission development plans, and demand forecasts, including preparation of system reinforcement recommendations.
projects.koreaTitle: East Coast Transmission Constraint Mitigation, Korea
projects.koreaDescription: Completed an East Coast transmission constraint mitigation study (2023), an assessment of shared use for the Anin Unit 2 transmission line (2023), and a 154 kV transmission-cable slippage assessment (2024).
projects.mozambiqueTitle: Mozambique 220 kV Transmission Line Feasibility Studies
projects.mozambiqueDescription: Technical feasibility studies for the Namialo–Metoro (2015–16) and Metoro–Palma (2018) sections of Mozambique’s 220 kV transmission network.
projects.ethiopiaDescription: Feasibility study and construction management for an off-grid hybrid power system combining 250 kW of solar PV, 1,000 kWh of battery storage, and biomass and biodiesel generation.
projects.philippinesDescription: Technical advisory for the Logbon (Cobrador) Island solar-hybrid feasibility study and expansion planning, including work under ADB Mini-Grid Subproject A.
projects.factsTitle: Automated & Coordinated Control System for FACTS (UPFC)
projects.factsDescription: Developed and delivered a SCADA-integrated optimal operation and control system for the UPFC at Gangjin Substation to KEPCO Research Institute. Also contributed to a government-funded R&D program on coordinated control of a 100 MVA-class STATCOM, including operation on the KEPCO grid at Migeum Substation.
